# Fuji Recipe Converter (vendored)

`data.js` (film simulations, recipe schema, starter recipes), `engine.js` (recipe → LUT colour engine),
`export.js` (.xmp / .cube / text / share code) and `parser.js` (recipe text, share code, X RAW Studio import)
are copied unchanged from [sadziu/Fuji-Recipe-Converter](https://github.com/sadziu/Fuji-Recipe-Converter)
at commit `a6691ea0e880ddd5fd19d7ca2d48a502fb0e7e07`, under the MIT license (see `LICENSE`).

`vendor/tesseract/` (OCR) and `vendor/heic/` (HEIC decoding) are copied from the same repository; their
licences are listed in `vendor/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md` (the Lucide icons it mentions are not used here).

Not affiliated with Fujifilm. The looks are approximations, not reproductions, of in-camera processing.
